RoomSense: build, test, package

A quick reference for building RoomSense for each target, running the tests and making the package zip for the house panel. More in DOCUMENTATION.md §15–17 and tools/package/README.md.

Always build outside the source tree, in a directory of your own. In the examples, $RS is the repository checkout and $ATN the AcquaThermoNet one:

RS=/home/devel/Sviluppi/Pers/Thermonator
ATN=/home/devel/Sviluppi/Pers/HA_Hmi_Relay

1. Once, after the clone

cd $RS
git submodule update --init

The submodules are QtMqtt (ThirdParty/qtmqtt, v5.13.2, static, always) and BlueZ (ThirdParty/bluez, 5.50: libbluetooth static and the hciconfig tool, ARM only). The first build compiles them; they are rebuilt only when missing (after changing a submodule delete <build>/ThirdParty) or when the compiler options change.

2. Targets

TargetToolchainBLEOutput
Desktop x86_64 (reference)Qt 5.13.2, /home/devel/Sviluppi/Qt/5.13.2/bin/qmakegenerated readingsbin_x86_64/RoomSense
Desktop x86_64 (optional)Qt 5.15.x qmakegenerated readingsbin_x86_64/RoomSense
House panel UN65 (Cortex-A9)SDK /home/devel/Sviluppi/Sdk/1.3.x (Cortex-A7) + -mcpu=cortex-a9real HCI scanbin_arm/RoomSense, hciconfig + package zip in dist/

> The SDK compiles for the Cortex-A7, the house panel is a Cortex-A9 > without hardware integer division: ThirdParty/thirdparty.pri adds > -mcpu=$$RS_ARM_CPU (default cortex-a9) to our code and to the static > libraries. Check: objdump -d bin_arm/RoomSense | grep -cE '(s|u)div' > must print 0, or the panel stops with "Illegal instruction". Another > panel: qmake RS_ARM_CPU=<cpu>.

2.1 Desktop

mkdir -p ~/build/rs-desktop && cd ~/build/rs-desktop
/home/devel/Sviluppi/Qt/5.13.2/bin/qmake -r $RS/RoomSense.pro
make -j$(nproc)
./bin_x86_64/RoomSense --version

To run it: from a directory with a setting.ini (created from the template copied next to the binary at the first start). The desktop build generates the readings of the [SENSORS]; events with RS_FAKE:

cd ~/build/rs-desktop/bin_x86_64
RS_FAKE="spike=0@4:+80;lost=1@20;press=0@10:+2;mode=window@30" ./RoomSense

Syntax in fakescenario.h: lost, back, spike, out, step, cold, nobatt, press (panel presses), mode (house mode); the sensor index is the [SENSORS] group order, alphabetical.

Never on the real broker with the real zone names: a live AcquaThermoNet would take the generated readings and commands. Use a local broker (e.g. $ATN/tools/minibroker.py 1883 broker.log) or the test zones of tools/broker_check.sh.

HTTPS (weather) with the Qt 5.13 desktop needs an OpenSSL 1.1, e.g. the one built by AcquaThermoNet: LD_PRELOAD="<atn build>/ThirdParty/openssl/libcrypto.so <atn build>/ThirdParty/openssl/libssl.so".

2.2 House panel

source /home/devel/Sviluppi/Sdk/1.3.x/environment-setup-cortexa7hf-neon-poky-linux-gnueabi
mkdir -p ~/build/rs-arm && cd ~/build/rs-arm
qmake -r $RS/RoomSense.pro
make -j$(nproc)
ls dist/

Every ARM link also makes the package zip (§4). A Qt Creator kit without the SDK environment variables is handled (archiver, no FORTIFY in -O0 debug builds).

2.3 qmake options

OptionEffect
CONFIG+=testsalso build the unit tests (tests/tests)
CONFIG+=packagedesktop: make the package zip too
CONFIG+=nopackageARM: no package zip
RS_ARM_CPU=<cpu>ARM: CPU of the panel (default cortex-a9)

make install: desktop to /tmp, ARM to /mnt/data/hmi/RoomSense (binary and setting.default.ini; setting.ini is never overwritten).

2.4 Version

From the latest git tag vX.Y.Z when qmake runs (version.pri): 3.0.0 at the tag, 3.0.0-<hash> after it, 0.0.0 with no tag reachable. The release tags live on the public branch, so a build of master reports 0.0.0-<hash>; a release is built from its tag. Rerun qmake -r after a commit or a tag (a plain qmake on the subdirs project keeps the old version.h).

3. Tests

What each test checks: TESTING.md.

3.1 Unit tests

No BLE, broker or display needed (desktop build, offscreen by default):

mkdir -p ~/build/rs-tests && cd ~/build/rs-tests
/home/devel/Sviluppi/Qt/5.13.2/bin/qmake -r $RS/RoomSense.pro CONFIG+=tests
make -j$(nproc)
./tests/tests

All the suites run in one go; each prints a Totals: line and the last line is OK: 0 failed test function(s) (exit status 0) or FAIL: …. Quick check: ./tests/tests 2>&1 | grep -E '^Totals|FAIL|OK:'.

3.2 End to end, with AcquaThermoNet

RoomSense and the real AcquaThermoNet (desktop builds), through the broker and relay board simulators of AcquaThermoNet, about two minutes:

$RS/tools/e2e.sh ~/build/rs-tests/bin_x86_64/RoomSense \
    <atn build>/bin_x86_64/AcquaThermoNet $ATN

It runs in its own network namespace (unshare -rn, no root): it cannot reach a real broker and does not disturb instances that are running.

3.3 Against the real broker

Only on test zones (e2e_test_1, e2e_test_2) that AcquaThermoNet ignores; the password from the environment, never on the command line:

MQTT_PASSWORD=... $RS/tools/broker_check.sh ~/build/rs-desktop/bin_x86_64/RoomSense <host> 1883 <user>

No other RoomSense may run on the PC (single instance).

4. Package zip for the house panel

4.1 From a build

The ARM build (§2.2) makes, after every link:

dist/RoomSense_Package_Arm32_<version>.zip     installed by JMLauncher
dist/RoomSense_Arm32_<version>.debug           not stripped, keep it for core dumps

The binaries in the zip (RoomSense, hciconfig) are stripped. A make that relinks nothing makes no new zip. By hand, SDK environment loaded:

$RS/tools/package/make_package.sh --bin-dir ~/build/rs-arm/bin_arm --arch Arm32 \
    --strip arm-poky-linux-gnueabi-strip

4.2 Release package

From the release tag (on public), in a clean checkout:

git -C $RS worktree add /tmp/rs-v3.0.0 v3.0.0
cd /tmp/rs-v3.0.0 && git submodule update --init
source /home/devel/Sviluppi/Sdk/1.3.x/environment-setup-cortexa7hf-neon-poky-linux-gnueabi
mkdir build && cd build && qmake -r ../RoomSense.pro && make -j$(nproc)

Before installing, check:

CheckCommandExpected
versionunzip -p dist/*.zip package.info<version>3.0.0</version>, no hash
no hardware division`objdump -d bin_arm/RoomSense \grep -cE '(s\u)div'`0
contentunzip -l dist/*.zipdeploy/RoomSense, deploy/hciconfig, deploy/start.sh, deploy/setting.default.ini, the hooks
checksum(cd dist && sha256sum *.zip > RoomSense_Package_Arm32_3.0.0.zip.sha256)kept with the zip

Then keep the zip with its .debug and remove the worktree (git -C $RS worktree remove /tmp/rs-v3.0.0).

4.3 Install

Copy the zip to the house panel and install it from the launcher. An update keeps setting.ini and log/. On a first install the application creates setting.ini from setting.default.ini: edit it (broker, sensor MACs and zones, screen saver, weather) and restart. RoomSense and AcquaThermoNet must be updated together when the interface changes.
